title: AlertRule/RecordingRule dual-write to legacy SQL via compat.go
answers: Why does AlertRule write to the old SQL alert_rule table?
Where does the k8s AlertRule get converted to/from the legacy ngmodels.AlertRule?
What happens if GetLegacyStorage gets an unknown resource type?
body: AlertRule and RecordingRule are not unified-storage-native: pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go's AppInstaller.GetLegacyStorage routes their GVRs to pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/alertrule|recordingrule:NewStorage, which translates between the k8s v0alpha1.AlertRule and legacy ngmodels.AlertRule via pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/alertrule/compat.go:convertToK8sResource and convertToDomainModel/convertToBaseDomainModel. RuleSequence and Config return nil from GetLegacyStorage, so they are served natively from unified storage. GetLegacyStorage panics on an unrecognized GVR (register.go ~line 339) rather than returning an error.
